title: Primes and the sieve of Eratosthenes
summary: Trial division up to √n for one number; the sieve marks multiples of each prime to find all primes below n in O(n log log n).

sections.title: Is n prime?
sections.body: ✍️ Check divisors from 2 up to √n (`i * i <= n`). If none divides n, it is prime. O(√n).

sections.title: All primes below n
Where it appears
sections.body: Count primes (LeetCode 204), prime factorisation of many numbers (store the smallest prime factor), closest prime pairs in a range.
